name: GravityOps Forum – Lite
author: BrightLeaf Digital

sections.description:
GravityOps Forum turns Gravity Forms forms and entries into a working forum with categories, forums, topics, and replies, while keeping entries as the canonical data source.

Paid features include:
* Template Hijacking: Override default plugin templates within your own WordPress theme.
* Nested Forums: Create sub-categories and multi-level forum hierarchies.
* Additional Fields: Map additional Gravity Forms fields to display in topic and reply content.
* Gravity Forms Feeds: Use native feeds to automate topic/reply creation with full conditional logic support.
* Follow Content & Email Alerts: Enable users to follow topics, forums, and other users with automatic email notifications for new activity.
* Advanced Role Mapping: Map WordPress roles to specific forum access sets.
* Forum Boards: Group forums into logical boards.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1 | Jun 15, 2026

  • Improved the upgrade experience when moving from the free version to premium.
  • Added safeguards to help prevent activation issues when both versions are present during an upgrade.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
